speaker: Doctor
text: I need to understand the nature of your symptoms better. Have you noticed any recent changes in your bowel habits, such as persistent diarrhea or constipation? Also, have you experienced any unexplained bruising or bleeding gums recently?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that information. Given your significant weight loss and night sweats, have you noticed any lumps in your neck or armpits, or any jaundice (yellowing) of your skin or eyes? Additionally, does the abdominal pain feel worse after eating?

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Hodgkin Lymphoma. The combination of supraclavicular lymphadenopathy (fixed and painless), B-symptoms (fever, night sweats, weight loss), and abdominal pain is highly suggestive of this condition. I am requesting a CT scan of the abdomen and pelvis and a biopsy of the lymph node to confirm.
